notes.title: Major bug fixes and graphics optimization update!
notes.content:
Thank you all so much for experiencing my game recently. Seeing everyone's love and support for this game really touches me.
This gives me the motivation to keep working on updates! I'm truly grateful to everyone!
This update has fixed many bugs, but adjustments are still ongoing.
Here are the issues currently fixed:

1.Added options to select windowed, fullscreen, or borderless fullscreen mode.
2.Added options to select screen resolution and adapted photo display for different resolutions.
3.Added sound effects for jumping and picking up photos.
4.Introduced dynamic photo display and added filters to make them look more like instant photos.
5.Added a level reset function, so you no longer need to restart the game when stuck and want to replay a level.
6.Optimized Talia's jumping - now she won't get stuck on walls anymore!
7.Added an auto-save feature, allowing you to resume from the last level you were on when you quit the game (currently being tested, may be updated soon).
